Fields.Name: Animation ID
Fields.Description: The animation ID within a category (3000 for a000_003000). With an offset type other than None, the game adds the category at runtime, so the same ID can play from several time acts.

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Generators
Fields.Description: The generators to choose from: one per variant of the animation (by weapon category, idle category, or animation offset; see Offset Type).

Fields.Name: Offset Type
Fields.Description: How the game picks the generator: by an animation ID offset, the idle category, the weapon's category (right hand, left hand or hand style), the magic or sword art category, or none (always the first).

Fields.Name: Animation End Event Type
Fields.Description: What the game does when the animation ends: fire the next state's event, the state end event, or the idle event, or nothing.

Fields.Name: Enable Script
Fields.Description: Whether the action script's functions for this animation run while it plays.

Fields.Name: Enable TAE
Fields.Description: Whether the animation's time act events run while it plays.

Fields.Name: Change Of Selected Index After Activate
Fields.Description: What a change of the selected generator does after the selector has activated: nothing, a self transition, or an update to the new generator.

Fields.Name: Generator Changed Transition Effect
Fields.Description: The transition effect used when the selected generator changes while active.

Fields.Name: Check Animation End Slot
Fields.Description: The animation slot whose end is checked for the end event. -1 for the default.

Fields.Name: Replanning AI
Fields.Description: Whether the AI re-plans its actions when this animation starts.
